title: Union Depot, Victor (image 208-9902): the library's description

quote: Research indicates that this is the Midland Terminal Railroad Depot in Victor, Colorado, built in 1895 for the Midland Terminal Railway. ... The building was placed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1984. It is located at the southeast corner of 4th Street and Granite Avenue in Victor.
